summary: This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5). Florida Power & Light Co. is offering first mortgage bonds in three series due 2036, 2056, and 2066 at unspecified prices and rates. Interest is semi-annual starting December 1, 2026. The bonds are secured by the lien of FPL's mortgage. No redemption premium or tax credit event details are provided. Book-entry delivery via DTC is expected in June 2026. This filing does not constitute a special situation—it is a routine capital markets transaction with no control or structural event.
